component_name: FastAPI Synthetic Microservices (api-gateway; auth-service; transaction-service; notification-service; db-dummy)
responsibility: Serve 5 linked synthetic microservices and propagate trace/correlation context across >=2 dependency hops
input_contract: HTTP JSON requests + W3C traceparent + X-Correlation-ID + signed fault hook commands
output_contract: Typed HTTP JSON responses + stdout structured logs + /metrics RED series + OTLP spans
producer_to_consumer: Traffic Generator -> api-gateway -> auth-service & transaction-service -> db-dummy & notification-service -> OTel/Backends

state_and_persistence: Stateless for gateway/auth; bounded SQLite/in-memory state for db-dummy and notification queue reset between runs
open_decisions: Exact queue payload fields closed via D-C02-01; fault hook port in C04
resource_considerations_8gib_cap: 5 single-worker containers at ~80-120 MiB RAM each (~500 MiB total ESTIMATE)
